questions.question: In the complex number system, which of the following is equal to (9 - 8i)(6 - i)? (Note: i = sqrt(-1))
questions.explanation: Multiplying out, the real part is (9)(6) - (-8)(-1) = 46 (using i^2 = -1) and the imaginary part is (9)(-1) + (-8)(6) = -57, so the product is 46 - 57i.

questions.question: In the complex number system, which of the following is equal to (5 - 4i)(7 - 8i)? (Note: i = sqrt(-1))
questions.explanation: Multiplying out, the real part is (5)(7) - (-4)(-8) = 3 (using i^2 = -1) and the imaginary part is (5)(-8) + (-4)(7) = -68, so the product is 3 - 68i.

questions.question: In the complex number system, which of the following is equal to (9 - 2i)(-8 - 8i)? (Note: i = sqrt(-1))
questions.explanation: Multiplying out, the real part is (9)(-8) - (-2)(-8) = -88 (using i^2 = -1) and the imaginary part is (9)(-8) + (-2)(-8) = -56, so the product is -88 - 56i.

questions.question: In the complex number system, which of the following is equal to (2 + 9i)(5 - 9i)? (Note: i = sqrt(-1))

questions.question: In the complex number system, which of the following is equal to (4 + 2i)(-4 - 3i)? (Note: i = sqrt(-1))
